description.zh:
您需创建的Group ID。取值说明如下：

- 以 "GID_" 或者 "GID-" 开头，只能包含字母、数字、连字符（-）和下划线（_），长度限制在 7~64 字符之间。
- Group ID 一旦创建，则无法修改，详情请参见[名词解释](~~42420~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the group to create. This ID must meet the following requirements:

- The ID must be 7 to 64 characters in length, start with `GID_` or `GID-`, and contain only letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.

- Group IDs cannot be modified after creation. For more information, see [glossary](~~42420~~).

description.zh: 创建的Group ID所在的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the instance to which the group ID belongs.
An array of tag key-value pairs.

descriptions.zh: 每成功调用一次 **CreateGroupId** 接口，都会计算为一次消息 TPS，从而影响您的计费。详情请参见[计费说明](~~52819~~)。
descriptions.en: Each successful call to the **CreateGroupId** operation counts as one message TPS and affects your billing. For more information, see [billing](~~52819~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt create-group-id --group-id GID_test --instance-id mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000 --tag Value=test Key=test --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt CreateGroupId --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key test --InstanceId 'mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000' --Tag.1.Value test --GroupId GID_test
